what_it_does: Modern data centers move enormous amounts of data between servers at very high speeds. This work uses lasers (VCSELs—vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers) to send data optically instead of electrically, which is more energy efficient. The key innovation is a direct-drive approach: they integrate the laser driver and the receiver amplifier right next to the VCSEL, eliminating extra chips that would normally re-time the signal. The design achieves this by using special inductor-based circuits to clean up the signal without needing additional processing, reaching 108 billion bits per second at very low power (0.9 picojoules per bit).
